objective: Build a small village together: at least three houses, a farm and a path between them. Always use `go_through_door` to pass closed doors. On this server you keep your inventory when you die. Items on the ground belong to nobody: walk over them to pick them up, and do it soon because they vanish after 5 minutes. Before dark, craft a sword and get under cover or stay ready to fight, because hostile mobs spawn at night. Do not wait for someone to ask: when your task is done, pick the next unfinished part of the village and start on it.
